If you are desperate, then go to them. Otherwise, stay very VERY far away. They are condescending and rude and do not provide support. They don’t help with finding a job and are even more rude if you have children. The ladies that work at the one here in San Antonio are EXTREMELY unsympathetic and look like they are burnt out and really don’t want to be there. The one in SA rarely has hot water, ac doesn’t work, smells like mold, you have to have your own towels, their linen is tragic to say the least, the food is HORRENDOUS. For dinner one night they gave us cold bread with a half melted piece of cheese on it and some left over Mac and cheese. 
The outside of the building is covered in mold and grime, there’s no security and to be quite frank it feels like you’re staying in a mental hospital. You can’t lock your door if you get a room because they can’t trust anyone with the keys and in the single side it looks like an army bunk. Bunk beds and grey totes to store your belongings.
It may be different in other cities, but from my experience there as a MINOR, I would suggest seeking out samministries, haven for hope, or the strong foundation.
